topics.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
topics.hnTitle: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says

topics.title: Preliminary Report Oct 21st Security Incident (Railway)

topics.title: The Goose Programming Language
topics.sourceVerification: HN title confirmed via browser fetch (page title: 'The Goose Programming Language | Hacker News'). Source page successfully extracted. Goose described as memory-safe systems language with no heap allocator, GC, or lifetime annotations. Claims: 3.3x speed of idiomatic C++, 1.16x hand-optimized C++, 1.12x best safe Rust, with less memory. Uses compiler-managed data stacks instead of heap.
topics.claimAccuracy: Accurate. Source confirms language description and benchmark claims.
